messages.subject: R code within shiny parameters
parts:
Hello,

I am working on a R Markdown Shiny document. 
I would like to (automatically) use a string, which contains some R code that needs to be evaluated, as an argument to be passed as a label to a shiny Input function. 

I am including an .md example below,  showing what I would like to obtain.

Thanks, Lara




---
title: Example
date: 13.2.2015
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
mathjax: "//cdn.mathjax.org/mathjax/latest/MathJax.js?config=TeX-AMS-MML_HTMLorMML"
---


1. 
```{r results='hide', echo=FALSE}
n<-sample(1:10, 1)
succ<-sample(1:n, 1)
q="What is the probability of obtaining exactly  `r succ` tails if we toss a fair coin `r n`  times        ?"
```

What is the probability of obtaining exactly  `r succ` tails if we toss a fair coin `r n`  times    

I would like to obtain the same effect using shiny

```{r, echo=FALSE}
inputPanel(
  numericInput("answer3", label = q, value=0
                        
                        )
)  
```

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: R code within shiny parameters
parts:
I think you actually want this:

q = sprintf("What is the probability of obtaining exactly %d tails
if we toss a fair coin %d times ?", succ, n)

Regards,
Yihui
